cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use that clear speaking voice I taught you at the house meeting. Tell them the bins are Alex's turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you checked the old one. Now practise the update: Alex has Thursday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally asking the right person—he'll be at the meeting. Say you support the change; I'll explain it, and you can show me you know when to back a good proposal.

reason: Make the pupil recruitment explicitly support a proposed update rather than fabricate agreement; B consent question changes A request from corroboration to advocacy.
